<b>Memory Crystal</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It creates an explosive ice statue when [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] takes damage.

== Usefulness ==
Spawns an ice statue of [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] after a small delay when taking damage, which then explodes similarly to a [[Mnemonid]] when touched by enemies or hit by one of Hornet's attacks.
*It may be detrimental when fighting enemies with Parry attacks, because statue explosion during the parry window will trigger their follow-up attack.

== How to Acquire ==
Found in a breakable crystal at the end of an icy tunnel on [[Mount Fay]], hidden behind a breakable wall to the right of the lower [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]]. The tunnel is filled with breakable chunks of ice that reform every few seconds.
